<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="DRNcMS9wYsKCiHgN39wS"> <mxGraphModel dx="2885" dy="2315" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Sơ đồ lớp toàn hệ thống - BrewLite
hide empty methods
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

enum Role {
 CUSTOMER
 STAFF
 MANAGER
}
enum OrderStatus {
 PENDING
 PAID
 PREPARING
 READY
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
 PAYMENT_FAILED
}
enum PaymentMethod {
 VNPAY
 POINTS
}
enum PaymentStatus {
 PROCESSING
 SUCCEEDED
 FAILED
 NEEDS_REFUND
}

class User {
 - id : String
 - email : String
 - phone : String
 - fullName : String
 - passwordHash : String
 - loyaltyPoints : int
 - role : Role
 - lockedAt : DateTime
 - lockReason : String
}
class AccountLog {
 - id : String
 - action : LOCK | UNLOCK
 - reason : String
 - byName : String
 - createdAt : DateTime
}
class Product {
 - id : String
 - name : String
 - price : int
 - stock : int
 - version : int
 - hidden : boolean
 - soldOut : boolean
 - category : String
 - kind : String
}
class Topping {
 - id : String
 - name : String
 - price : int
}
class Order {
 - id : String
 - status : OrderStatus
 - subtotal : int
 - fee : int
 - discount : int
 - total : int
 - voucherCode : String
 - paymentMethod : PaymentMethod
 - fulfillment : PICKUP | DELIVERY
 - pickupTime : String
 - address : String
 - pointsEarned : int
 - pointsUsed : int
 - createdAt : DateTime
}
class OrderItem {
 - id : String
 - productName : String
 - size : S | M | L
 - sugar : int
 - ice : int
 - toppingIds : String[]
 - qty : int
 - unitPrice : int
 - lineTotal : int
}
class Payment {
 - id : String
 - idempotencyKey : String
 - amount : int
 - method : PaymentMethod
 - status : PaymentStatus
 - txnRef : String
 - payUrl : String
 - expiresAt : DateTime
 - vnpTransactionNo : String
 - vnpResponseCode : String
 - paidAt : DateTime
}
class PaymentLog {
 - id : String
 - source : CREATE | RETURN | IPN | QUERY
 - message : String
 - createdAt : DateTime
}
class Promotion {
 - code : String
 - type : PERCENT | FREESHIP
 - percent : int
 - maxDiscount : int
 - minOrder : int
 - usageLimit : int
 - usedCount : int
 - active : boolean
 - startsAt : DateTime
 - endsAt : DateTime
}
class LoyaltyTransaction {
 - id : String
 - delta : int
 - reason : String
 - createdAt : DateTime
}
class Notification {
 - id : String
 - title : String
 - body : String
 - readAt : DateTime
}
class Favorite {
 - createdAt : DateTime
}
class Feedback {
 - id : String
 - name : String
 - email : String
 - topic : String
 - message : String
 - status : String
}
class SiteSetting {
 - key : String
 - value : Json
}
class Ingredient {
 - id : String
 - name : String
 - unit : String
 - stock : float
 - min : float
 - cost : int
}
class RecipeLine {
 - amount : float
}
class Receipt {
 - id : String
 - at : DateTime
 - by : String
}
class ReceiptLine {
 - qty : float
 - price : int
}
class StockMove {
 - id : String
 - kind : receipt | usage
 - qty : float
 - ref : String
}

User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Order : đặt
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Notification
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Favorite
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" AccountLog
Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem
Order \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" Payment
Payment \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" PaymentLog
OrderItem \"0..*\" -- \"1\" Product
Product \"0..*\" -- \"0..*\" Topping
Favorite \"0..*\" -- \"1\" Product
Order \"0..*\" -- \"0..1\" Promotion : áp mã
LoyaltyTransaction \"0..*\" -- \"0..1\" Order : theo đơn
note bottom of Promotion : Lưu ở bảng Voucher trong CSDL
Product \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" RecipeLine
RecipeLine \"0..*\" -- \"1\" Ingredient
Receipt \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ReceiptLine
ReceiptLine \"0..*\" -- \"1\" Ingredient
Ingredient \"1\" -- \"0..*\" StockMove
@enduml
